title: Water-fuelled microwave electrothermal thruster flown by Momentus
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Water-fuelled microwave electrothermal thruster flown by Momentus, about recent at Space (Momentus space tug), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh, the uh I invented the water uh based microwave electrothermal thruster. Really? And using water as fuel, and I got it working, and now it's flown in space successfully.

plain: John Brandenburg, a physicist, told podcast host Jesse Michels that he invented a spacecraft engine that uses water as fuel, heating it with microwaves to make thrust. He says he got it working and that it has now flown successfully in space on a craft from a company called Momentus.
